title: ring_index bounds not enforced by type - relies on private fields
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Line: 300

The `rreq()` method accesses `EXPANDING_RING[self.ring_index]` without bounds checking. Safety relies on:
1. `ring_index` field being private
2. All constructors keeping it within bounds [0, 2]
3. `advance_ring()` checking before incrementing

While currently safe due to encapsulation, adding `#[cfg(test)]` constructors or `pub(crate)` visibility later could introduce panic paths.

Suggestion: Add `debug_assert!(self.ring_index < EXPANDING_RING.len())` in `rreq()` for defense in depth, or use `.get().expect()` with a clearer panic message.
